notes: One run per configuration, so the ± values are spread across the 3 evals, not run-to-run variance.
The JSON-shape assertion passes in both configurations and does not discriminate; every rule assertion does.
Baseline failures are the hard rules: commas and periods in 3 of 3 runs, hooks over 8 words, a second CTA ('שמרו את הפוסט') and hashtags after the CTA.
With the skill each run took about 4x longer (it reads references and runs the lint loop). Acceptable for one nightly run.

Qualitative: with-skill runs still added unsourced generalisations when no source was given (eval 1 'הרבה פעמים זה פחות קשור לצמא', eval 3 'יש ילדים שנפרדים תוך יומיים ויש כאלה שצריכים כמה שבועיים'). The lint cannot catch this; SKILL.md now tells the writer not to add facts the input did not contain.
